scripts.ci:static: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
scripts.ci:storybook: pnpm build:storybook && pnpm test:storybook && pnpm --filter @comma/ui test:e2e
scripts.ci:build:web: pnpm build:web:prod && pnpm build:admin:prod && pnpm check:foundation
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:web && COMMA_SKIP_NATIVE_BUILD=1 pnpm build:electron && playwright test --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.smoke:admin: COMMA_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:65535 pnpm build:admin && playwright test --config apps/admin/playwright.config.ts
scripts.smoke:auth:electron:local: COMMA_SKIP_NATIVE_BUILD=1 pnpm build:electron && COMMA_ELECTRON_LOCAL_AUTH_SMOKE=1 COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=electron-shell apps/electron/e2e/chat-runtime-ownership.spec.ts --grep "local passwordless login"
scripts.smoke:chat:electron:real: COMMA_SKIP_NATIVE_BUILD=1 pnpm build:electron && COMMA_ELECTRON_REAL_CHAT_SMOKE=1 COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=electron-shell apps/electron/e2e/chat-runtime-ownership.spec.ts --grep "real provider streams one continuous reply"
scripts.smoke:electron: COMMA_SKIP_NATIVE_BUILD=1 pnpm build:electron && COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_DIR=playwright-report/electron COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_REPORT_FILE=playwright-report/electron/results.json COMMA_PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/playwright-electron playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=electron
